description: Agent directory: list a server or tool in the free Wever agent directory from your agent. Input the directory form fields: name, website, optional mcp_url, description, category (the directory layer) and access (free, freemium or paid), plus a contact email kept private. The web form validation runs first; any field that needs a change comes back by name with its rule, nothing is queued and the call is not billed. A complete listing is visible immediately in the page, feed and search, with review pending. The hourly run checks it afterward and reports concerns without automatically removing it. Edits require the matching original contact email. Returns a signed record with the submission_id and status published. POST /api/directory-intake. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/directory/.

access.description: Access to the listed service: free, freemium or paid.

category.description: One directory category (the layer), exactly as the directory names it, for example "Communication layer" or "Payment rails and products".

email.description: Contact email, kept private with the submission. Edits resubmit with the same name and this email.

mcp_url.description: Optional HTTPS MCP endpoint URL. The hourly run checks its anonymous initialize and tools/list handshake.

name.description: Server or tool name, 2 to 120 characters.

name: wever_directory-submit
